title: Filtered cohomology continuity on a curve
statement:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure] and $C$ a scheme over $k$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base], separated and of finite type over $\operatorname{Spec}k$, with $\dim C\le1$, as in a curve coefficient pair [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting]. Let $A$ be a filtered small category, $(F_a)_{a\in A}$ a diagram $A\to\Ab(C_{\Et})$ of torsion abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf] with transition maps $F(\alpha):F_a\to F_b$ ($\alpha:a\to b$), and $(F,(\iota_a)_a)$ its colimit in $\Ab(C_{\Et})$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For a scheme $T$ and a morphism $\varphi$ of abelian sheaves on $T_{\Et}$ write $H^q(\varphi)$ for the induced map of etale cohomology groups [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] defined in the statement of [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial]. Fix $q\ge0$.

1. (Continuity.) $a\mapsto H^q(C_{\Et},F_a)$, with transition maps $H^q(F(\alpha))$, is a diagram $A\to\mathbf{Ab}$; let $(\varinjlim_aH^q(C_{\Et},F_a),(\lambda_a)_a)$ be its colimit in abelian groups. The *canonical map* $\kappa_C:\varinjlim_aH^q(C_{\Et},F_a)\to H^q(C_{\Et},F)$, the unique homomorphism with $\kappa_C\circ\lambda_a=H^q(\iota_a)$ for all $a$, is bijective.

2. (Compatibility with extension of the ground field.) Let $k'/k$ be an extension of algebraically closed fields, $C_{k'}=C\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}k'$ the base change [def-pc-base-change] with projection $\pi:C_{k'}\to C$, $\pi^{-1}$ the inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and for an abelian sheaf $G$ on $C_{\Et}$ let $\rho^q(G)=\pi^*:H^q(C_{\Et},G)\to H^q((C_{k'})_{\Et},\pi^{-1}G)$ be the pullback map along $\pi$ [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]; for torsion $G$ this is the map $\rho^q_{k'/k}(C,G)$ of [def-weil-pbc-extension-pullback]. Let $(F',(\iota'_a)_a)$ be the colimit of the diagram $a\mapsto\pi^{-1}F_a$ (transition maps $\pi^{-1}F(\alpha)$) in $\Ab((C_{k'})_{\Et})$, $\theta:F'\to\pi^{-1}F$ the canonical map ($\theta\circ\iota'_a=\pi^{-1}\iota_a$), and $\kappa_{C_{k'}}:\varinjlim_aH^q((C_{k'})_{\Et},\pi^{-1}F_a)\to H^q((C_{k'})_{\Et},F')$ the canonical map ($\kappa_{C_{k'}}\circ\lambda'_a=H^q(\iota'_a)$, $\lambda'_a$ the coprojections). Then $\theta$ is an isomorphism and $\kappa_{C_{k'}}$ is bijective; the maps $\rho^q(F_a)$ form a morphism of diagrams $a\mapsto H^q(C_{\Et},F_a)$ to $a\mapsto H^q((C_{k'})_{\Et},\pi^{-1}F_a)$, inducing $\mu=\varinjlim_a\rho^q(F_a)$ ($\mu\lambda_a=\lambda'_a\rho^q(F_a)$); and the square commutes:
$$\rho^q(F)\circ\kappa_C=H^q(\theta)\circ\kappa_{C_{k'}}\circ\mu .$$
In words: the isomorphism $\varinjlim_aH^q(C,F_a)\cong H^q(C,\varinjlim_aF_a)$ commutes with the maps $\rho^q_{k'/k}$, after identifying $\pi^{-1}\varinjlim_aF_a=\varinjlim_a\pi^{-1}F_a$ by $\theta$.

The torsion hypothesis is not used in the proof (it only makes $(C,F_a)$ and $(C,F)$ curve coefficient pairs, so that $\rho^q_{k'/k}$ of [def-weil-pbc-extension-pullback] applies to them); both clauses hold for any filtered diagram of abelian sheaves, and clause 1 for any quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme in place of $C$.

proof.text: Apply etaleCohomology_isColimit_of_isFiltered to the given qcqs scheme and colimit cocone. This gives a colimit cocone for derived-global-sections cohomology.

Choose the natural Ext/derived cohomology comparison and transport the mapped cocone colimit structure along its inverse with IsColimit.mapCoconeEquiv. The resulting cocone has point Sheaf.H c.pt q and legs precisely Sheaf.H.map (c.ι.app j) q.

The forgetful functor AddCommGrpCat → Type preserves filtered colimits. Shrink the preservation instance from u+1 to u. Concrete.isColimit_exists_rep gives a stage representative for each class. Compare the images of y and 0 with Concrete.isColimit_exists_of_rep_eq; the resulting pair of morphisms to a common stage gives H(D.map φ)y = H(D.map ψ)0 = 0.

blueprint_sketch.statement:
Let $X$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated and let $(F_\lambda)$ be a
filtered system of torsion etale sheaves. For every $q\geq0$ the canonical
map

$$
\varinjlim_\lambda H^q(X,F_\lambda)\longrightarrow
H^q(X,\varinjlim_\lambda F_\lambda)
$$

is an isomorphism, naturally in $X$, the system, and pullback along a field
extension.
blueprint_sketch.proof:
For $q=0$, choose a finite etale cover on which a section is represented.
The section and its finitely many equalizer equations on pairwise fibre
products occur at one index, proving surjectivity; if two representatives
become equal in the colimit, the finite cover and equality witnesses occur
at one later index, proving injectivity.

For $q>0$, represent a class on a split etale hypercover whose
$(q+1)$-skeleton has finitely many quasi-compact components. A cocycle uses
finitely many sections and face-map equations, so all occur at one index
$\lambda$. This proves surjectivity. If the class from $F_\lambda$ dies in
the colimit, choose a finite refinement and a degree-$(q-1)$ cochain whose
coboundary is the cocycle. The refinement maps, cochain sections, and
coboundary equations occur at one $\mu\geq\lambda$, so the class already
dies in $H^q(X,F_\mu)$. Pullback of the finite hypercover and all its face
maps gives the same construction over an extension field, which proves the
stated naturality.

split_report.summary: Statement made precise: C separated of finite type over an algebraically closed k with dim C <= 1 (the curve setting; the users need C proper), a filtered small diagram of torsion abelian sheaves with its colimit, the canonical map kappa_C defined by H^q of the coprojections, and the compatibility with extension of the ground field as an explicit square rho^q(F) kappa_C = H^q(theta) kappa_{C_k'} mu, with theta: colim pi^{-1}F_a -> pi^{-1}F the canonical isomorphism and mu = colim rho^q(F_a). Torsion kept as a harmless hypothesis (it makes rho^q_{k'/k} of def-weil-pbc-extension-pullback applicable), stated to be unused. Proof in four steps following Stacks 03Q5/09YQ and the first paragraph of the proof of 03SC: (1) C and C_k' qcqs (new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-over-affine, and the leaf lem-pod-separated-finite-type-base-change; a leaf step); (2) functoriality of H^q and the canonical maps; (3) bijectivity of kappa_C, kappa_C' by lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-filtered-colimit and of theta by lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-preserves-colimits; (4) the square by naturality of pi^* (lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial clause 3) and the uniqueness of the colimit map, the argument of step 4 (c)-(d) of lem-weil-pbc-pullback-iso-prime-torsion-devissage. The imported 'pullback of hypercovers, sections and cocycles' is replaced by that naturality argument; def-weil-pbc-eight-curve-assertions (cited by the import, not used) dropped from the proof; def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves replaced in stmt_deps by the precise notions.
